## What this does

Reproduces the Familias *Blind search* relationships in R, without the GUI:

* **Direct-match** (clone / true-to-type / synonym)
* **Parent–Child**
* optional, exploratory: **Full-sib**, **Half-sib**, **Cousins**

Per-locus IBD likelihoods `P(genotypes | IBD = 0,1,2)` follow Milligan (2003, *Genetics*
163:1153); realised IBD (κ0,κ1,κ2) are estimated by ML; kinship φ = κ1/4 + κ2/2 and
**r = 2·φ = κ1/2 + κ2**. Output columns mirror the Familias blind-search list, plus **r**
and a triage **Note**.

> **Reliability.** 14 SSRs resolve **clone** and **parent–child** well. Full/half-sib and
> cousins are shown only if you ask for them and are *not* reliable at 14 (let alone 6) SSRs —
> read them as hypotheses to check, not conclusions. See the 6-locus note at the end.

## Parameters — edit here

```{r params}
setwd("C:/R/UA_Cherry_ID/")                       # project root
geno_file  <- "C:/R/UA_Cherry_ID/data/ECPGR_2021_Ordidge_Barreneche_Cherry DB.txt"
#geno_file  <- "C:/R/UA_Cherry_ID/data/EU Cherry Barreneche, 2021, 14 SSR - 314 genotypes. 14 SSR data.txt"

freq_file  <- "C:/R/UA_Cherry_ID/data/AFP_ECPGR_Sw.Cherry ID - Ordidge_Barreneche, 2021, ECPGR - Familias_recalc.txt"
#query_file  <- "C:/R/UA_Cherry_ID/data/UKR_Cherry_90_harmonised_query.txt"
query_file <- NULL  # optional: path to YOUR samples (same wide data format, e.g. harmonised UKR).
                     # If set, those samples are searched against the reference DB.
query_names<- NULL   # or restrict to names already in the DB, e.g. readLines("ukr_query_ids.txt")
query_vs_db_only <- TRUE  # TRUE = Accession 2 is reference-DB only (drop query-vs-query rows)

results_dir<- "C:/R/UA_Cherry_ID/results/cherry_ID"
out_prefix <- "ECPGR_2021_Ordidge_Barreneche_Cherry_ID_matches_R_test_2"
#out_prefix <- "UKR_Cherry_vs_EU.Cherry_Barreneche_Cherry_ID_matches"

search_modes    <- c("Direct-match", "Parent-Child")   # "Parent-Child" add "Full-sib","Half-sib","Cousins"
match_threshold <- 1     # Direct-match: max mismatching loci
pc_max_incons   <- 1     # Parent-Child: max Mendelian (IBS=0) loci
min_overlap     <- 6     # min co-typed loci for a pair to be reported
bin_tol         <- 1     # allele match tolerance in bp (1 = merge 151/152-type wobble; 0 = exact)
mutation_rate   <- 0     # 0 = as Familias (no mutation); >0 gives 1-inconsistency PC pairs a small LR
dm_lr_min       <- 1   #1e4 # Direct-match: min LR to report (0 = all; raise to keep only rare-genotype clones)
rel_share_min   <- 0   #0.50 relatives prefilter: min fraction of shared alleles
rel_lr_min      <- 100   # relatives: min LR to report a Full/Half-sib or Cousin row
```

## Load data (+ optional query file)

```{r load}
read_geno <- function(path) read.table(path, sep = "\t", header = TRUE, check.names = FALSE,
                                       quote = "", comment.char = "", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
db <- read_geno(geno_file)
loci <- unique(sub(" [12]$", "", colnames(db)[-1])); L <- length(loci)

build_mat <- function(d, loci) {
  s <- as.character(d[[1]]); n <- length(s)
  A1 <- matrix(0L, n, L); A2 <- matrix(0L, n, L)
  for (k in seq_along(loci)) {
    c1 <- paste0(loci[k], " 1"); c2 <- paste0(loci[k], " 2")
    a <- if (c1 %in% colnames(d)) suppressWarnings(as.integer(d[[c1]])) else rep(0L, n)
    b <- if (c2 %in% colnames(d)) suppressWarnings(as.integer(d[[c2]])) else rep(0L, n)
    a[is.na(a)] <- 0L; b[is.na(b)] <- 0L; A1[, k] <- a; A2[, k] <- b
  }
  list(samp = s, A1 = A1, A2 = A2)
}
m <- build_mat(db, loci); samp <- m$samp; A1 <- m$A1; A2 <- m$A2

is_query_file <- !is.null(query_file)
if (is_query_file) {
  q <- build_mat(read_geno(query_file), loci)
  samp <- c(samp, q$samp); A1 <- rbind(A1, q$A1); A2 <- rbind(A2, q$A2)
  query_idx <- (length(m$samp) + 1):length(samp)
}
n <- length(samp)
miss <- (A1 == 0L | A2 == 0L)
lo <- pmin(A1, A2); hi <- pmax(A1, A2); lo[miss] <- 0L; hi[miss] <- 0L

# allele frequencies (exact; no global binning)
fl <- sub("\r$", "", readLines(freq_file, warn = FALSE)); freq <- list(); cur <- NULL
for (ln in fl) {
  if (ln == "") next
  f <- strsplit(ln, "\t")[[1]]
  if (length(f) == 1 || (length(f) >= 2 && f[2] == "")) {
    cur <- trimws(f[1]); if (!(cur %in% names(freq))) freq[[cur]] <- numeric(0); next }
  al <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(f[1])); fr <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(f[2]))
  if (!is.na(al) && !is.na(fr)) freq[[cur]][as.character(al)] <- fr
}
eps <- 1e-6
pf  <- function(loc, a) { v <- freq[[loc]][as.character(a)]; if (length(v) == 0 || is.na(v)) eps else max(v, eps) }
dir.create(results_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
cat(sprintf("Reference %d samples; total %d; %d loci; bin_tol=%d bp.\n",
            length(m$samp), n, L, bin_tol))
```

## Core functions

```{r functions}
# local per-pair snap: move each Y allele onto an X allele if within bin_tol (fixes 1 bp wobble
# WITHOUT merging distinct alleles globally). X,Y are length-2 sorted integer vectors.
snapY <- function(X, Y) {
  if (bin_tol <= 0) return(Y)
  for (i in 1:2) if (!(Y[i] %in% X)) { d <- abs(X - Y[i]); w <- which(d <= bin_tol)
    if (length(w)) Y[i] <- X[w[1]] }
  sort(Y)
}

# Milligan per-locus IBD-state likelihoods c(L0,L1,L2)
L012 <- function(loc, xa, xb, ya, yb) {
  pa <- pf(loc,xa); pb <- pf(loc,xb); pc <- pf(loc,ya); pd <- pf(loc,yb)
  xh <- xa == xb; yh <- ya == yb
  if (xh && yh) { if (xa == ya) return(c(pa^4, pa^3, pa^2)) else return(c(pa^2*pc^2, 0, 0)) }
  if (xh && !yh) { if (xa == ya || xa == yb) { po <- if (xa == ya) pd else pc
      return(c(2*pa^3*po, pa^2*po, 0)) }; return(c(2*pa^2*pc*pd, 0, 0)) }
  if (yh && !xh) { if (ya == xa || ya == xb) { po <- if (ya == xa) pb else pa
      return(c(2*pc^3*po, pc^2*po, 0)) }; return(c(2*pc^2*pa*pb, 0, 0)) }
  if (setequal(c(xa,xb), c(ya,yb))) return(c(4*pa^2*pb^2, pa*pb*(pa+pb), 2*pa*pb))
  sh <- intersect(c(xa,xb), c(ya,yb))
  if (length(sh) == 1) { i <- sh; j <- if (xa == i) xb else xa; k <- if (ya == i) yb else ya
    pi <- pf(loc,i); pj <- pf(loc,j); pk <- pf(loc,k); return(c(4*pi^2*pj*pk, pi*pj*pk, 0)) }
  c(4*pa*pb*pc*pd, 0, 0)
}

KAPPA <- list(`Parent-Child` = c(0,1,0), `Full-sib` = c(.25,.5,.25),
              `Half-sib` = c(.5,.5,0), `Cousins` = c(.75,.25,0))
relLR <- function(M, kap) { num <- kap[1]*M[,1] + kap[2]*M[,2] + kap[3]*M[,3]
  prod(ifelse(M[,1] > 0, num / M[,1], 0)) }

ml_kappa <- function(M) {
  negll <- function(par) { k0 <- par[1]; k1 <- par[2]; k2 <- 1-k0-k1
    if (k0 < -1e-9 || k1 < -1e-9 || k2 < -1e-9) return(1e12)
    v <- k0*M[,1] + k1*M[,2] + k2*M[,3]; if (any(v <= 0)) return(1e12); -sum(log(v)) }
  gr <- seq(0,1,0.1); best <- list(val = Inf, par = c(1,0))
  for (k0 in gr) for (k1 in gr[gr <= 1-k0]) { v <- negll(c(k0,k1))
    if (v < best$val) best <- list(val = v, par = c(k0,k1)) }
  op <- optim(best$par, negll, method = "Nelder-Mead", control = list(reltol = 1e-8))
  k <- c(op$par[1], op$par[2], 1-op$par[1]-op$par[2]); k <- pmax(k, 0); k/sum(k)
}

pair_full <- function(i, j) {
  ov <- 0L; sh <- 0L; ibs2 <- 0L; ibs1 <- 0L; ibs0 <- 0L
  dmLR <- 1; dm_inc <- 0L; M <- list()
  for (k in seq_len(L)) {
    if (lo[i,k] == 0 || lo[j,k] == 0) next
    ov <- ov + 1L
    X <- c(lo[i,k], hi[i,k]); Y <- snapY(X, c(lo[j,k], hi[j,k]))
    xa <- X[1]; xb <- X[2]; ya <- Y[1]; yb <- Y[2]
    ms <- if (xa == xb) (ya == xa) + (yb == xa)
          else as.integer(ya == xa || yb == xa) + as.integer(ya == xb || yb == xb)
    sh <- sh + ms
    if (ms == 2L) ibs2 <- ibs2 + 1L else if (ms == 1L) ibs1 <- ibs1 + 1L else ibs0 <- ibs0 + 1L
    if (ms == 2L) { pgt <- if (xa == xb) pf(loci[k],xa)^2 else 2*pf(loci[k],xa)*pf(loci[k],xb)
      dmLR <- dmLR / pgt } else dm_inc <- dm_inc + 1L
    M[[length(M)+1]] <- L012(loci[k], xa, xb, ya, yb)
  }
  M <- do.call(rbind, M); k <- ml_kappa(M)
  phi <- k[2]/4 + k[3]/2
  list(ov = ov, sh = sh, ibs2 = ibs2, ibs1 = ibs1, ibs0 = ibs0,
       dmLR = dmLR, dm_inc = dm_inc, M = M, k0 = k[1], k1 = k[2], k2 = k[3],
       phi = phi, r = 2*phi,
       pcLR = relLR(M, KAPPA[["Parent-Child"]]),
       pc_inc = sum(M[,2] <= 0))
}
```

## Screening (query × database, with ±bin_tol tolerance)

```{r screen}
if (exists("query_idx")) {
  qidx <- query_idx
} else if (!is.null(query_names)) {
  qidx <- match(query_names, samp); qidx <- qidx[!is.na(qidx)]
} else {
  qidx <- seq_len(n)
}
allvsall <- !exists("query_idx") && is.null(query_names)

cand <- list()
for (qi in qidx) {
  if (allvsall) {
    js <- if (qi == n) integer(0) else (qi+1):n
  } else {
    js <- setdiff(seq_len(n), qi)
    if (query_vs_db_only) {
      js <- js[ !(js %in% qidx) ]           # Accession 2 = reference DB only
    } else {
      js <- js[ !(js %in% qidx & js < qi) ] # keep query-query pairs, reported once
    }
  }
  if (!length(js)) next
  ov <- integer(length(js)); ms2 <- integer(length(js)); ibs0 <- integer(length(js)); shf <- integer(length(js))
  for (k in seq_len(L)) {
    xl <- lo[qi,k]; xh <- hi[qi,k]; if (xl == 0) next
    yl <- lo[js,k]; yh <- hi[js,k]; typed <- yl != 0
    if (xl == xh) sK <- (abs(yl-xl) <= bin_tol) + (abs(yh-xl) <= bin_tol)
    else sK <- as.integer(abs(yl-xl) <= bin_tol | abs(yh-xl) <= bin_tol) +
               as.integer(abs(yl-xh) <= bin_tol | abs(yh-xh) <= bin_tol)
    sK[!typed] <- 0L
    ov <- ov + typed; shf <- shf + sK
    ms2 <- ms2 + (sK == 2L & typed); ibs0 <- ibs0 + (sK == 0L & typed)
  }
  mism <- ov - ms2; frac <- ifelse(ov > 0, shf/(2*ov), 0)
  ok <- ov >= min_overlap
  want_rel <- any(c("Full-sib","Half-sib","Cousins") %in% search_modes)
  pick <- which(ok & ( (mism <= match_threshold) | (ibs0 <= pc_max_incons) |
                       (want_rel & frac >= rel_share_min) ))
  for (t in pick) cand[[length(cand)+1]] <- c(qi, js[t])
}
cat(sprintf("Candidate pairs after screening: %d\n", length(cand)))
```

## Build the Familias-style table

```{r build}
rows <- list()
mk <- function(i, j, rel, LR, inc, p, note) data.frame(
  `Accession 1` = samp[i], `Accession 2` = samp[j], Relationship = rel, LR = LR,
  Inconsistencies = inc, `Overlapping markers` = p$ov, Cluster = NA_integer_, `Shared alleles` = p$sh,
  `IBS=2` = p$ibs2, `IBS=1` = p$ibs1, `IBS=0` = p$ibs0, `Kinship coefficient` = round(p$phi,4),
  Kappa0 = round(p$k0,3), Kappa1 = round(p$k1,3), Kappa2 = round(p$k2,3),
  `Coefficient of relationship r` = round(p$r,4), Note = note,
  check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

for (c1 in cand) {
  i <- c1[1]; j <- c1[2]; p <- pair_full(i, j)
  is_clone <- p$dm_inc <= match_threshold
  if ("Direct-match" %in% search_modes && is_clone && p$dmLR >= dm_lr_min)
    rows[[length(rows)+1]] <- mk(i, j, "Direct-match", p$dmLR, p$dm_inc, p, "clone/synonym")
  if ("Parent-Child" %in% search_modes && p$pc_inc <= pc_max_incons && !is_clone) {
    note <- if (p$k2 < 0.05 && abs(p$r - 0.5) <= 0.10) "P-O candidate" else "sib/relative (k2>0)"
    rows[[length(rows)+1]] <- mk(i, j, "Parent-Child", p$pcLR, p$pc_inc, p, note)
  }
  for (rl in intersect(c("Full-sib","Half-sib","Cousins"), search_modes)) {
    LR <- relLR(p$M, KAPPA[[rl]])
    if (LR >= rel_lr_min && !is_clone)
      rows[[length(rows)+1]] <- mk(i, j, rl, LR, p$ibs0, p, "exploratory (>=14 SSR unreliable)")
  }
}
res <- if (length(rows)) do.call(rbind, rows) else data.frame()

if (nrow(res)) {
  # clusters = connected components of the Direct-match graph
  parent <- seq_len(n)
  find <- function(x) { while (parent[x] != x) x <- parent[x]; x }   # read-only union-find
  dm <- res[res$Relationship == "Direct-match", ]
  for (r in seq_len(nrow(dm))) {
    a <- match(dm[["Accession 1"]][r], samp); b <- match(dm[["Accession 2"]][r], samp)
    ra <- find(a); rb <- find(b); if (ra != rb) parent[ra] <- rb
  }
  cl <- as.integer(factor(sapply(seq_len(n), find)))
  res$Cluster <- cl[match(res[["Accession 1"]], samp)]
  res <- res[order(factor(res$Relationship, levels = c("Direct-match","Parent-Child","Full-sib","Half-sib","Cousins")),
                   -res$LR), ]
  outfile <- file.path(results_dir, paste0(out_prefix, ".txt"))
  write.table(res, outfile, sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)
  cat("written: ", outfile, "\n")
  cat(sprintf("Direct-match: %d | Parent-Child: %d | other: %d\n",
      sum(res$Relationship=="Direct-match"), sum(res$Relationship=="Parent-Child"),
      sum(!res$Relationship %in% c("Direct-match","Parent-Child"))))
}
knitr::kable(head(res, 40), digits = 4)
```

## Verification ("double check")

```{r verify}
s <- pair_full(1, 1)
stopifnot(s$ibs2 == s$ov, abs(s$k2 - 1) < 1e-2, abs(s$r - 1) < 1e-2, s$pc_inc == 0)   # self = clone
ii <- match("Iputj [LVA001018]", samp); jj <- match("Iput [EST012-020]", samp)         # known synonym
if (!is.na(ii) && !is.na(jj)) print(unlist(pair_full(ii, jj)[c("ibs2","dm_inc","k2","r")]))
if (nrow(res)) {
  cat(sprintf("max |phi-(k1/4+k2/2)| = %.3g ; max |r-2phi| = %.3g\n",
      max(abs(res$`Kinship coefficient` - (res$Kappa1/4 + res$Kappa2/2))),
      max(abs(res$`Coefficient of relationship r` - 2*res$`Kinship coefficient`))))
}
```

## Notes on the 6-locus query, and on tolerance

* **`query_file`**: put your samples (harmonised, same wide format) in a separate file and set
  `query_file`; they are appended to the reference and searched against it (and against each other).
  Only loci present in both are compared, so a UKR sample typed at the **6 ECPGR-overlap loci**
  yields `Overlapping markers = 6`.
* **6-locus reliability.** The search *runs* fine at 6 loci, but 6 SSRs carry far less power:
  a Direct-match at 6 loci can be coincidental. **Judge 6-locus hits by the LR, not the
  inconsistency count** — a clone needs a high Direct-match LR (rare multilocus genotype);
  a low LR means the genotype is common and the "match" may be chance. Parent-child at 6 loci
  is weak and full/half-sib essentially uninformative — treat those as leads only.
* **`bin_tol` (default 1 bp)** applies a *local per-pair* snap (e.g. 151↔152), which fixes
  cross-dataset binning wobble (as in the two Aelita records) and reproduces Familias, **without**
  globally merging distinct alleles. Set `bin_tol = 0` for exact integer matching.
* **Note column**: `P-O candidate` (κ2 ≈ 0 and r ≈ 0.5) vs `sib/relative (k2>0)` — use it to tell a
  true parent–offspring from a full-sib inside a matched cluster (14 SSRs cannot separate them by
  inconsistencies alone).
